import unittest

from ledger import importer
from ledger.accounts import default_chart
from ledger.journal import Entry, Journal, Line
from tests.helpers import d


class Currency(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_a_missing_currency_is_usd(self):
        e = importer.read_csv("entry,date,memo,account,amount\n1,2026-01-05,X,1000,1.00\n1,2026-01-05,X,3000,-1.00\n")[0]
        self.assertEqual({l.currency for l in e.lines}, {"USD"})

    def test_an_entry_in_two_currencies_is_refused(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            Journal(default_chart()).post(Entry(d("2026-01-05"), "X", [Line("1000", 1, "EUR"), Line("3000", -1)]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
